input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 sits at the preferred position. The cap is expressly mutual and set at the greater of Fees "paid or payable" in the twelve months preceding the event and USD 1,000,000 (21.1); "Fees" (1.5) captures recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the base is meaningful rather than illusory. The consequential-damages exclusion is mutual and is improved for us by confirming data restoration, replacement services, notification and incident-response costs are direct damages (21.2). "Excluded Claims" sit outside both the cap and the exclusion and cover confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP (21.3), and Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is expressly not "damages" limited by the Section. Section 18.2 confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities, and 21.4 preserves the independence of each cap and survival beyond failure of an exclusive remedy. Minor point noted only: "Fees" excludes a one-time implementation charge unless an Order Form states otherwise, slightly narrowing the fee base, but the USD 1,000,000 floor mitigates this. No cap, mutuality or carve-out defect exists, so no redline is proposed.
